note: Monroe County Conservation park on 135-acre Lake Miami, 5 mi east of Lovilia and 7 mi north of Albia. The camp loops are in woods east of the county road (635th Ave); the lake, its three boat ramps and the shore day-use area are west of the road. Rental cabins, open and enclosed shelters, a nature education center, an elk exhibit, fish cleaning station and hiking trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $17 electric / $22 full hookup, 20/30/50-amp electric, water and sewer, 53 sites, showers. Booking changed from reservable online to FCFS with phone reservations for holidays only. Season changed from ~Apr 1-Nov 1 to April 1-September 30. Not waterfront stands.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront stands. Imagery: the camp loops sit east of the north-south county road (635th Ave) in woods and lawn, ~100-200 m from the lake's east shore. The road, then the boat-ramp lane and shore day-use area, lie between, so the best possible call is a view, and no page or photo shows one. The mycountyparks pages carry no per-site map or photos.
